# Rule book (generated by v4/book.py; do not edit by hand)

The runner loads `rules/floor/` + `rules/accepted/`.

**floor tier** - reimplementations of the BASELINES, in Python over `v4.api`, never retired. The floor
alone is meant to reach the best of every baseline on every circuit, so a new idea is scored against the
best baseline, not against zero. Do not propose a floor rule's idea again.

**accepted tier** - original discoveries. Retired after two global loops with no accepted application.

| tier | name | kind | error | resources | idea | measured |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| floor | pauli_exponential_commutation_merge | procedure | exact | unitary | Move every rotation to the circuit front as a signed n-qubit Pauli exponential (X/Y/Z-type, multi-qubit), so Hadamards do not cut. Two rotations with equal Paulis merge (angles add with sign) if the later one commutes with all rotation Paulis between them; the edit is made in place in the original op list. | hhl_8: 29331 -> 29205 = pyzx exactly (with the frame rule);
                            29273 alone from the TKET input |
| floor | pauli_frame_rotation_merge | procedure | exact | unitary | Move a later Z-rotation backwards through the Clifford ops between (its axis becomes C^dag P C per op) and past rotations whose Z commutes with that axis; if it lands as +-Z on an earlier rotation's qubit, the two angles add (a_i + s a_j) and the later op is deleted. Exact up to global phase. |  |
| accepted | and_ancilla_ccz_lowering_with_measured_uncompute | reconstruction | exact | measured | ccz/ccx(x,y,z) = AND-compute(x,y->a) [4 T]; cz/cx(a,z); measured uncompute [0 T]. A run of ccz/ccx with the same control pair whose controls are not written in between shares one AND, so a run costs 4 T total instead of 7 T per gate. Runs are disjoint, so a single clean ancilla is reused. |  |
| accepted | bilinear_rank_resynthesis_karatsuba | reconstruction | exact | measured | A Toffoli-level segment whose CCZ groups only add products of read-only registers A, B into targets Y is the classical bilinear map y ^= M(a,b). Recompute M from a rank decomposition (Karatsuba: 9 products for 4x4 GF(2) polynomial multiplication instead of 16 monomials): fan the linear forms into two ancillas, AND them with a 4-T gadget, CX the result into the targets, uncompute by measurement (0 T). |  |
| accepted | free_fermion_gaussian_resynthesis | procedure | approx | unitary | If every non-Clifford rotation, after pushing Cliffords to the end, is a Pauli rotation about a Majorana bilinear (Jordan-Wigner, directly or Hadamard-conjugated), the circuit is a Gaussian unitary whose action on the Majoranas is one orthogonal matrix R in O(2n). Multiply the plane rotations into R, factor it by a Givens cascade into at most n(2n-1) adjacent-plane rotations, re-emit each as a Pauli rotation and append the residual Clifford. Equal up to global phase; error is only floating point in the factorization. |  |
| accepted | pauli_subalgebra_dimension_recompression | procedure | approx | unitary | Push Cliffords out of a run of rotations so it becomes an ordered product of Pauli exponentials; the product lies in the compact group of the Lie algebra generated by the axes (closure under products of anticommuting pairs), of dimension d. If d is smaller than the number of rotations, refit the run as at most d (or 2d) rotations on the closure basis by least squares, snap/drop angles, accept only at distance <= 1e-10 with fewer non-Clifford rotations. |  |
